title: P2 EXECUTED -- the outer-profile decomposition at cluster scale
law: rho_ph(r) = A/r^2, A = sqrt(G M_b a0)/(4 pi G), M_b = enclosed baryons at R500 (G075 convention); deep window (r_M, R500), r_M = sqrt(G M_b/a0); rho_dust = rho_tot - A/r^2 - rho_b
prediction: V1: envelope slope d ln rho_dust/d ln r in (-2.5, -2.0) on the pooled window (NFW-class); r_x = (A/rho_dust_scale)^(1/2); V2: phantom never exceeds the residual
data: committed X-COP ingests, real_research/data/xcop/ (Eckert+19/Ettori+19 FITS M_FORW, MGAS, MSTAR + xcop_r500_ettori2019.json); identical loader as G050/G057/G075; M_NFW NOT used (would pre-bake the tested class); residual slope certified -1.53 on 75-420 kpc is the straddling-window number (g04a/G008)

verdicts_checks.V3_honest_statement: THE OUTER HALO AT CLUSTER SCALE = THE LAW'S PHANTOM + THE DUST ENVELOPE: V1 PASS, V2 FAIL.  Per cluster the law's A/r^2 (A from M_b(R500), zero parameters) was subtracted from the committed X-COP hydrostatic shells over the deep window (r_M, R500), r_M = 273-580 kpc on this convention.  V1: the pooled envelope slope is -2.38 +- 0.15 against the NFW-class prediction (-2.5, -2.0) -- INSIDE the band; per-cluster slopes span -7.15 .. +2.31 (in-band 2/12 clusters).  V2: the phantom exceeds the residual in 34/292 window bins (-- the subtraction is unphysical there).  The crossover r_x where rho_ph = rho_dust: numeric in-window crossings at A3266:1004; the task-formula prediction (A/rho_dust_scale)^(1/2) at ref r_M gives 484 kpc median (256-2720).  THE HONEST END: the decomposition does not fully close: the phantom asks for mass the residual does not carry -- the decomposition fails at the amplitude side (the r_M equipartition: M_ph(<r_M) = M_b(R500) exceeds the observed dark mass there in 34/292 of the window bins).  The amplitude of the dust envelope and the EFE cap line stay the registered open numbers (KEPLER_GRADE 'open numbers'); the raw residual slope on this deep window alone is median -2.29, vs the certified -1.53 on the 75-420 kpc straddling window (g04a/G008).

checks.name: V0a [gate: the deep window r > r_M exists for every cluster] r_M from the registered M_b(R500) convention (G075) vs R500 from the committed Ettori+19 table
checks.measured: 12/12 clusters have r_M < R500; r_M range 273.4-580.2 kpc (median 401.6); window octaves 1.2-1.9 (self-consistent iterate r_M* median 17.3 kpc, context only)
checks.reading: the inverted regime map: inside r_M the law is OFF (g_N > a0 in the core, G016/H012 A1); the P2 window is the OUTER halo, r_M -> R500.  G057's registered column (b) gave 296-958 kpc (a different M_b convention); G075's R500-anchored convention reproduced here, 273-580 kpc (median ~400), the task's '100-300 kpc' ballpark is the lower-mass end

checks.name: V0b [gate: the committed ingest reproduces G075's registered rows] median M_gas/M_NFW at 420 kpc over the 12 clusters, read off the committed FITS this run (the registered target: X-COP f_b(420) = 0.127 +/- 0.02, G008/G050), and median M_b(R500) vs G075's row
checks.reading: the same files, same interpolation, same band as G050/G057/G075 -- this row reproduces their registered V0 digit-for-digit (0.163, range 0.101-0.219; the prior lanes FAIL it too): the committed ingest is the same one; the +0.036 offset vs the published 0.127 is the registered on-disk quirk of these rows (G075 V0a, unchanged)

checks.name: V1a [per-cluster data gate] every cluster yields a dense window and at least 3 positive-dust bins for the envelope slope
checks.measured: bins per cluster: 18-29; positive-dust slope fits: 12/12
checks.reading: bins are the committed M_FORW shells with midpoint in (r_M, R500); a negative bin is a V2 violation, not a fit point

checks.name: V1 [THE ENVELOPE SLOPE on the pooled window] the free-dust envelope d ln rho_dust/d ln r over the pooled (r > r_M) window lies in the NFW-class band (-2.5, -2.0)
checks.measured: pooled slope = -2.377 +- 0.152 (n = 258 bins, rms 0.38 dex); per-cluster median -2.79, in-band 2/12 clusters
checks.reading: the raw observed residual slope rho_tot - rho_b on the same window sits at median -2.29 (the certified -1.53, g04a, is measured on 75-420 kpc -- a window straddling r_M; here the deep window runs r_M -> R500 as P2 mandates).  The phantom subtraction A/r^2 keeps the envelope inside the NFW band: the honest reading of the decomposition is the verdict below

checks.name: V2 [the phantom never exceeds the residual] rho_dust(r) = rho_tot - A/r^2 - rho_b >= 0 in EVERY window bin of EVERY cluster (the subtraction stays physical; equivalently M_ph(<r) <= M_dyn(<r) - M_b(<r) over (r_M, R500))
checks.measured: 34/292 bins negative (11.6%); min rho_ph/residual over the pooled window = 0.286 (A644, 435 kpc)
checks.reading: the phantom is a FIXED A/r^2 with A from M_b(R500); at r_M the phantom enclosed mass is M_b(R500) by the equipartition identity (G03E), so the consistency asks the cluster's observed dark mass at r_M to already exceed M_b(R500) -- the empirical statement the X-ray data answer here
